# Vinetra: Multiplayer Survival


**Features**

🌲SURVIVE THE WILD
- Physics based locomotion makes movement fun and engaging. Use your hands to run, climb, and survive in a large open world designed for movement.

- Every life is a new attempt. Master the mechanics, learn the map, and survive longer than your last run. Permadeath coming soon in a free update!


🎒CRAFT & TRADE
- Inventory management: Every slot matters. Balance your resources between food, tools & materials.

- Sell & Trade for the weapons you need to survive the night. From primitive weapons to essential gear, your survival depends on what you can get.

⚔️12 PLAYER BATTLES
- You aren't alone. Compete or cooperate with up to 12 players in a free for all environment where placing full trust in someone can end in your demise.

⚠️EARLY ACCESS NOTE
- **Vinetra is in early access.** Please expect bugs. Report them in-game, or in our Discord server, and help make Vinetra better for everyone!

**Join the official Vinetra Discord server:** discord.gg/w7RexKP7Ng

**How long can YOU last?**
